chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 104: Ji Ning Achieves the Raindrop Sword Domain!
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning achieves a monumental breakthrough, merging with the Dao to form his Raindrop Sword Domain! But the Snowdragon Mountain threat escalates as they recruit a terrifying Fiendgod expert.
og_description: Ji Ning merges with the Dao in a stunning rainy epiphany, forming a Domain of his own. But back in the real world, a storm of terrifying experts is gathering.
twitter_title: 🌊 New Domain Unlocked! Ji Ning masters the Dao of Raindrops!
